ExposedAmountPartyA.name: Exposed Amount Party A
ExposedAmountPartyA.definition: Sum of the exposures of all transactions which are in the favour of party A. That is, all transactions which would have an amount payable by party B to party A if they were being terminated.

ExposedAmountPartyB.name: Exposed Amount Party B
ExposedAmountPartyB.definition: Sum of the exposures of all transactions which are in the favour of party B. That is, all transactions which would have an amount payable by party A to party B if they were being terminated.

ExposureType.name: Exposure Type
ExposureType.definition: Underlying business area/type of trade that triggered the posting of collateral.

TotalValueOfCollateral.name: Total Value Of Collateral
TotalValueOfCollateral.definition: Total value of the collateral (post-haircut) held by the exposed party.

NetExcessDeficit.name: Net Excess Deficit
NetExcessDeficit.definition: Amount of collateral in excess or deficit compared to the exposure.

NetExcessDeficitIndicator.name: Net Excess Deficit Indicator
NetExcessDeficitIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the collateral actually posted is a long or a short position.

ValuationDateTime.name: Valuation Date Time
ValuationDateTime.definition: Date/time at which the collateral was valued.

RequestedSettlementDate.name: Requested Settlement Date
RequestedSettlementDate.definition: Date on which the instructing party requests settlement of the collateral to take place.

SummaryDetails.name: Summary Details
SummaryDetails.definition: Additional details on the valuation of the collateral that is posted.
